lines.zh: 我用腹足吸住湿润的叶面。
lines.en: My belly feet cling to the damp leaf.
I grip the leaf's edge and inch along.
My feeding leaves notches in the leaf.
I don't dare leave this leaf.
I follow the veins of the leaf.
I creep along the vein inch by inch.
I test the next leaf with my forelegs.
I crawl to the underside of the leaf.
I lift my head to find a way.
The leaf tip sways; I hold on.
I creep into the sunlight.
Behind me lies a trail of eaten leaf.
I cross over a thick vein.
I'm very slow, but I don't rest.
This part of the leaf is tender.
I try not to tip over the edge.
I cling to the leaf without moving.
I curl my front half.
I'm chewing a leaf.
Wind keeps the leaf rocking.
My color matches the leaf's underside.
I pause to let my belly digest.
A bird sweeps overhead.
I hold tight and stay still.
This is my whole world.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，看了看远处
lines.en: I raise my front and look beyond.
That other leaf looks acceptable too.
I count the droplets along the vein.
Your face is so large.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看你在做什么
lines.en: I lift my head to see what you're doing.
Don't touch it; I'd fall.
You're outside the leaf, far away.
I retreat toward the leaf's stem.

lines.zh: 你的影子让这里变暗了
lines.en: Your shadow has darkened this spot.

lines.zh: 我不是虫子，我要变蝴蝶
lines.en: I'm no mere grub. I'll be a butterfly.
You reach out; I curl up.
This leaf can only hold me.
Look long enough, and I get used to it.
I curl up from the pain.
I cling to the leaf and won't let go.
My body pulls in a segment.
Green fluid leaks out.
I can't lift my front half.
I slip off the vein.
This wound stops my crawling.
I press myself flat to the leaf.
I'm still moving, so I'm still alive.
Bitter juice seeps from my green skin.
Is that a leaf?
I eat only leaves.
Bring it closer so I can look.
That one's more tender than mine.
I'll have to crawl over there first.
Don't put it on the ground.
I'd fall off.
Put it on a leaf and I'll come.
This is the only taste I take.
You're holding it too high.
You tapped the leaf; I hold on.

lines.zh: 你的手指碰得叶片直晃。
lines.en: Your finger sets the leaf rocking.

lines.zh: 你的手指比叶子重多了
lines.en: Your finger is far heavier than a leaf.
I roll back from the edge.
That set the leaf rocking a long while.

lines.zh: 湿地的叶面滑，我贴得低。
lines.en: Wetland leaves are slick, so I keep low.
The leaf has shifted.
I go to the underside.
Stop tapping; it'll snap.
I crawl back to the middle.
You're on the same leaf as I.
We can crowd a little and share.
The underside is cool; come over here.
You eat that end; I'll eat this.
We'll both become winged things.
Don't crawl far; you'll fall.

lines.zh: 我们在同一根叶脉上啃。
lines.en: We gnaw along the same leaf vein.
It's cooler under the leaf.
Let's chew along this vein together.

lines.zh: 到了时候，我们各自结蛹
lines.en: When the time comes, we each make our chrysalis.
I chew loose a small piece of leaf.
I can't bite through this.
I hold it with my forelegs.
It slipped out of my mouth.
This bite is tender.
I eat the flesh, not the veins.
Too dry; I can't swallow it.
I chew out a small hole.
This will last me half a day.
I bite the leaf edge but cannot drag it.
A nearby leaf is moving.
I raise my head that way.
There's something on it.
It's two leaves away.
I should go and see.
I stretch my front half out.
There's a gap between the stems.
I hesitate for a long while.
That leaf looks better.
I decide to crawl over.
I move forward bit by bit.
Forelegs first, body after.
I'm getting nearer the leaf's edge.
It's deep below; I can't see the bottom.
I grip the main vein.
Only a short way left.
I bridge the gap with my body.
Touch. I've got hold.
I haul my rear half across.
This is mine now too.
I rear up and butt once.
What little strength I have is slight.
I bite the leaf flesh; the sap is bitter.
It retreats, and so do I.

lines.zh: 湿地的叶太嫩，一咬就破。
lines.en: Wetland leaves tear at one bite.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把刺毛竖起来。
lines.en: I rear up and raise my bristles.
I flick a shower of leaf bits at you.
I only want to keep my leaf.
I crawl back to the leaf's center.
Don't come again.
I hatch out of the egg.

lines.zh: 第一口就吃了自己的壳
lines.en: My first meal was my own shell.
This leaf is my home.
I try one crawl forward.
Sunlight comes through the leaves.
I grip the leaf and dare not let go.
My body is still very small.
The smell of leaves is everywhere.
I know I must keep eating.
I begin to chew, slowly.
The leaf catches fire; I climb up.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，摔在土里
lines.en: I drop off the leaf and hit the soil.
Once soaked, I can't move.

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子和我们一起掀了
lines.en: The blast flings leaf and me together.
Something sharp goes right through me.

lines.zh: 一股力量把叶子定住了
lines.en: A force freezes the leaf in place.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完了，我越来越小
lines.en: The leaf is gone; I keep shrinking.
Lightning flares; every leaf rustles.

lines.zh: 叶子和我们一起往下掉
lines.en: The leaf and I fall together.
